name: thyroid stimulating hormone receptor

function.text: TSHR encodes thyrotropin receptor. Annotated molecular activities include signaling receptor activity and G protein-coupled receptor activity. It participates in cell-cell signaling and hormone-mediated signaling pathway.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to familial gestational hyperthyroidism (autosomal dominant); hypothyroidism due to TSH receptor mutations (autosomal recessive). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Colon Adenocarcinoma; Well-Differentiated Thyroid Cancer. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
